evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: Ratification language performs the settling of a contract; the declarative act records the decision as made.

evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work

observations.why: Operational rules stated as invariants the ratified contract enforces — 'no blocking call, and no lost work' functions as a never/always rule the speaker expects others to act on.

evidence.quote:
Key decision: remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

observations.why: Explicit 'Key decision' label followed by a settled operational pattern the speaker expects others to follow; the text performs the settling rather than arguing for it.
